claim: People have been to the deepest point in the ocean.

heard.who: Don Walsh, U.S. Navy lieutenant and co-pilot of the 1960 dive, in Scientific American (2014)
heard.quote: Our depth gage read 37,800 feet. We had found a new depth in the Challenger Deep!

answer: Yes. The deepest known point of the ocean is the Challenger Deep, at the southern end of the Mariana Trench. Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh were the first people to reach its bottom, on 23 January 1960, in the bathyscaphe Trieste. Its depth is about 10.9 to 11 kilometres; published figures differ with the survey.

facts.text: The Challenger Deep, a valley at the southern end of the Mariana Trench, is the deepest known point in the ocean.

facts.text: Published depths for the Challenger Deep differ by about 80 metres: roughly 10,911 m for the 1960 dive, 10,935 m in the figure most often quoted and 10,994 m in a later survey.
